H00985.indexNameEnAll: CSI All Share Total Return Index

sma120_crosscheck.method: 120 calendar-aligned actual trading observations; Decimal sum; close*120 > sum; equal is false

prior_CSI300_TR_freeze_check.scope: Same official vendor across two local freeze dates; not an independent second source or a complete historical-vintage audit.

notes: CSI_ALL_PRICE 000985 is price index used solely for market trend gate; no dividend adjustment is added to this gate.

CSI_ALL_TR H00985 and CSI300_TR H00300 are official total-return index levels including theoretical dividend reinvestment. They are performance references, not executable ETFs and contain no fund fees, commissions or tracking difference.
Use only already-confirmed daily closes; source historical revision vintages and intraday publication timestamps are not verified.
No missing values are forward/backfilled. Non-ETF-calendar observations are excluded with original observations retained in validation and raw responses.
